agent_note: FLAG -- lands in the 70-85% present audit band. 11 event quotes, 8 present / 3 past = 72.7% present. Prose fiction, not verse. Two structural signals support genuine present-tense narration: both dialogue-bucketed quotes carry PRESENT tags ('he says to Andrea', 'He looks at Willa'), and the book narrates past-set backstory in the historical present (q06053/q06054, Vivi's teenage years in Parma). The past minority does NOT cleanly trace to a memory strand: q06055 and q06058 are backstory/retrospective, but q06061 (the hospital, Vivi 'hadn't made it') is a plot event in plain past. Combined with q06043's 'Vivi has learned' in the present after that death, the text reads like an afterlife/observer frame narrating in present over a past-tense death scene -- hence narrating_situation 'dual' rather than 'simultaneous'. SENSITIVITY: the present count leans on three truncated or modal quotes (q06051 future auxiliary, q06052 truncated clause, q06059 list). Dropping all three gives 5 present / 3 past = 62.5%, which would fall out of the band and into low-confidence. Do not treat 72.7% here as firm.
